reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 i, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ، بْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ قُلْنَا لأَبِي سَعِيدٍ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَذْكُرُ فِي الْعَزْلِ شَيْئًا قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ الْقَدَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Ala narrated to us. Hisham narrated to us, from Muhammad, from Mabid ibn Sirin. He said: We asked Abu Sa'id whether he had heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) mention withdrawal. He said: Yes, and he related the hadith with the meaning of Ibn Awn's hadith up to the words: It is destiny.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Ala überlieferte uns. Hisham überlieferte uns, from Muhammad, from Mabid ibn Sirin. Er sagte: We asked Abu Sa'id whether he had heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) mention Coitus interruptus. Er sagte: Yes, and he related the hadith with the meaning of Ibn Awn's hadith up to the words: It is destiny. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 j, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، قَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدَةَ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ قَزَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ ذُكِرَ الْعَزْلُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَلِمَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ أَحَدُكُمْ - وَلَمْ يَقُلْ فَلاَ يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ أَحَدُكُمْ - فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَتْ نَفْسٌ مَخْلُوقَةٌ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ خَالِقُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri and Ahmad ibn Abdah narrated to us. Ibn Abdah said: He informed us, and Ubayd Allah said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from Qazah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He said: Withdrawal was mentioned before the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and he said: Why would any of you do that? He did not say: None of you should do that. There is no created soul except that Allah is its Creator.
translation_de: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri and Ahmad ibn Abdah überlieferte uns. Ibn Abdah said: He berichtete uns, and Ubayd Allah said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from Qazah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Er sagte: Withdrawal was mentioned before der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and he said: Why would any of you do that? He did not say: None of you should do that. There is no created soul except that Allah is its Creator. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 k, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ صَالِحٍ - عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَدَّاكِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْعَزْلِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ كُلِّ الْمَاءِ يَكُونُ الْوَلَدُ وَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ خَلْقَ شَىْءٍ لَمْ يَمْنَعْهُ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me. Abd Allah ibn Wahb narrated to us. Muawiyah, meaning Ibn Salih, informed me, from Ali ibn Abi Talhah, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He heard him say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about withdrawal and said: It is not from all fluid that a child is formed. When Allah intends to create something, nothing can prevent Him.
translation_de: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli überlieferte mir. Abd Allah ibn Wahb überlieferte uns. Muawiyah, meaning Ibn Salih, berichtete mir, from Ali ibn Abi Talhah, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He heard him say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about Coitus interruptus and said: It is not from all fluid that a child is formed. When Allah intends to create something, nothing can prevent Him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 l, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْبَصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَدَّاكِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ahmad ibn al-Mundhir al-Basri narrated to me. Zayd ibn Hubab narrated to us. Muawiyah narrated to us. Ali ibn Abi Talhah al-Hashimi informed me, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
translation_de: Ahmad ibn al-Mundhir al-Basri überlieferte mir. Zayd ibn Hubab überlieferte uns. Muawiyah überlieferte uns. Ali ibn Abi Talhah al-Hashimi berichtete mir, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1439 a, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ لِي جَارِيَةً هِيَ خَادِمُنَا وَسَانِيَتُنَا وَأَنَا أَطُوفُ عَلَيْهَا وَأَنَا أَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْزِلْ عَنْهَا إِنْ شِئْتَ فَإِنَّهُ سَيَأْتِيهَا مَا قُدِّرَ لَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَبِثَ الرَّجُلُ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْجَارِيَةَ قَدْ حَبِلَتْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ أَخْبَرْتُكَ أَنَّهُ سَيَأْتِيهَا مَا قُدِّرَ لَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ahmad ibn Abd Allah ibn Yunus narrated to us. Zuhayr narrated to us. Abu al-Zubayr informed us, from Jabir. A man came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said: I have a slave woman who serves us and waters our date palms, and I have intercourse with her, but I dislike that she become pregnant. He said: Withdraw from her if you wish, but what has been decreed for her will come to her. The man stayed away, then came and said: The slave woman has become pregnant. He said: I told you that what was decreed for her would come to her.
translation_de: Ahmad ibn Abd Allah ibn Yunus überlieferte uns. Zuhayr überlieferte uns. Abu al-Zubayr berichtete uns, from Jabir. A man came to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: I have a Sklavin who serves us and waters our date palms, and I have intercourse with her, but I dislike that she become schwanger. Er sagte: Withdraw from her if you wish, but what has been decreed for her will come to her. The man stayed away, then came and said: The Sklavin has become schwanger. Er sagte: I told you that what was decreed for her would come to her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1439 b, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ عِنْدِي جَارِيَةً لِي وَأَنَا أَعْزِلُ عَنْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَنْ يَمْنَعَ شَيْئًا أَرَادَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الْجَارِيَةَ الَّتِي كُنْتُ ذَكَرْتُهَا لَكَ حَمَلَتْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ashathi narrated to us. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn Hassan, from Urwah ibn Iyad, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. A man asked the Prophet (peace be upon him): I have a slave woman and I practice withdrawal with her. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: That will not prevent anything Allah has willed. The man then came and said: The slave woman I mentioned to you has become pregnant. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am the servant of Allah and His Messenger.
translation_de: Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ashathi überlieferte uns. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Sa'id ibn Hassan, from Urwah ibn Iyad, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. A man asked der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm): I have a Sklavin and I practice Coitus interruptus with her. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: That will not prevent anything Allah has willed. The man then came and said: The Sklavin I mentioned to you has become schwanger. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am the servant of Allah and His Messenger. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1439 c, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، قَاصُّ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَدِيِّ بْنِ الْخِيَارِ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Hajjaj ibn al-Shair narrated to us. Abu Ahmad al-Zubayri narrated to us. Sa'id ibn Hassan, the storyteller of the people of Makkah, narrated to us. Urwah ibn Iyad ibn Adi ibn al-Khiyar al-Nawfali informed me, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the meaning of Sufyan's hadith.
translation_de: Hajjaj ibn al-Shair überlieferte uns. Abu Ahmad al-Zubayri überlieferte uns. Sa'id ibn Hassan, the storyteller of the people of Makkah, überlieferte uns. Urwah ibn Iyad ibn Adi ibn al-Khiyar al-Nawfali berichtete mir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. A man came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the meaning of Sufyan's hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1440 a, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَعْزِلُ وَالْقُرْآنُ يَنْزِلُ ‏.‏ زَادَ إِسْحَاقُ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ لَوْ كَانَ شَيْئًا يُنْهَى عَنْهُ لَنَهَانَا عَنْهُ الْقُرْآنُ.
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Ishaq said: He informed us, and Abu Bakr said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Amr, from Ata, from Jabir. He said: We practiced withdrawal while the Quran was being revealed. Ishaq added: Sufyan said: If it had been something forbidden, the Quran would have forbidden us from it.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. Ishaq said: He berichtete uns, and Abu Bakr said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Amr, from Ata, from Jabir. Er sagte: We practiced Coitus interruptus while the Quran was being revealed. Ishaq added: Sufyan said: If it had been something forbidden, the Quran would have forbidden us from it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1440 b, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ لَقَدْ كُنَّا نَعْزِلُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
translation_en: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me. Hasan ibn Ayan narrated to us. Maqil narrated to us, from Ata. He said: I heard Jabir say: We practiced withdrawal during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him).
translation_de: Salamah ibn Shabib überlieferte mir. Hasan ibn Ayan überlieferte uns. Maqil überlieferte uns, from Ata. Er sagte: I heard Jabir say: We practiced Coitus interruptus during the time of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1440 c, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَعْزِلُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَنْهَنَا ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Ghassan al-Mismai narrated to me. Muadh, meaning Ibn Hisham, narrated to us. My father narrated to me, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. He said: We practiced withdrawal during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). This reached the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him), but he did not forbid us.
translation_de: Abu Ghassan al-Mismai überlieferte mir. Muadh, meaning Ibn Hisham, überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte mir, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. Er sagte: We practiced Coitus interruptus during the time of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). This reached the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him), but he did not forbid us. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1441 a, book 16, باب تَحْرِيمِ وَطْءِ الْحَامِلِ الْمَسْبِيَّةِ ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ وَطْءِ الْحَامِلِ الْمَسْبِيَّةِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ أَتَى بِامْرَأَةٍ مُجِحٍّ عَلَى بَابِ فُسْطَاطٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُلِمَّ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَلْعَنَهُ لَعْنًا يَدْخُلُ مَعَهُ قَبْرَهُ كَيْفَ يُوَرِّثُهُ وَهُوَ لاَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ كَيْفَ يَسْتَخْدِمُهُ وَهُوَ لاَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Jafar narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Yazid ibn Khumayr. He said: I heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr narrate from his father, from Abu al-Darda, from the Prophet (peace be upon him). A woman who was far along in pregnancy was brought to him at the door of a tent. He said: Perhaps he intends to have intercourse with her. They said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I intended to curse him with a curse that would enter his grave with him. How could he inherit the child when it is not lawful for him? How could he use it when it is not lawful for him?
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Jafar überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from Yazid ibn Khumayr. Er sagte: I heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr narrate from his father, from Abu al-Darda, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). A woman who was far along in pregnancy was brought to him at the door of a tent. Er sagte: Perhaps he intends to have intercourse with her. They said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I intended to curse him with a curse that would enter his grave with him. How could he inherit the child when it is not lawful for him? How could he use it when it is not lawful for him? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1441 b, book 16, باب تَحْرِيمِ وَطْءِ الْحَامِلِ الْمَسْبِيَّةِ ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ وَطْءِ الْحَامِلِ الْمَسْبِيَّةِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us. Abu Dawud narrated to us. All of them narrated from Shubah through this chain.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Yazid ibn Harun überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Bashshar überlieferte uns. Abu Dawud überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Shubah through this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1442 a, book 16, باب جَوَازِ الْغِيلَةِ وَهِيَ وَطْءُ الْمُرْضِعِ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْعَزْلِ
title: باب جَوَازِ الْغِيلَةِ وَهِيَ وَطْءُ الْمُرْضِعِ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْعَزْلِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ جُدَامَةَ بِنْتِ وَهْبٍ الأَسَدِيَّةِ أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَنْهَى عَنِ الْغِيلَةِ حَتَّى ذَكَرْتُ أَنَّ الرُّومَ وَفَارِسَ يَصْنَعُونَ ذَلِكَ فَلاَ يَضُرُّ أَوْلاَدَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ وَأَمَّا خَلَفٌ فَقَالَ عَنْ جُذَامَةَ الأَسَدِيَّةِ ‏.‏ وَالصَّحِيحُ مَا قَالَهُ يَحْيَى بِالدَّالِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Khalaf ibn Hisham narrated to us. Malik ibn Anas narrated to us. Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, and his is the wording. He said: I read to Malik, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah. She heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: I intended to forbid intercourse during breastfeeding, then I remembered that the Romans and Persians do that and it does not harm their children. Muslim said: Khalaf said Judhamah al-Asadiyyah, but what Yahya said with a d is correct.
translation_de: Khalaf ibn Hisham überlieferte uns. Malik ibn Anas überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns, and his is the wording. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah. She heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: I intended to forbid intercourse during Stillen, then I remembered that the Romans and Persians do that and it does not harm their children. Muslim said: Khalaf said Judhamah al-Asadiyyah, but what Yahya said with a d is correct. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1442 b, book 16, باب جَوَازِ الْغِيلَةِ وَهِيَ وَطْءُ الْمُرْضِعِ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْعَزْلِ
title: باب جَوَازِ الْغِيلَةِ وَهِيَ وَطْءُ الْمُرْضِعِ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْعَزْلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ، بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ جُدَامَةَ بِنْتِ وَهْبٍ، أُخْتِ عُكَّاشَةَ قَالَتْ حَضَرْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أُنَاسٍ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَنْهَى عَنِ الْغِيلَةِ فَنَظَرْتُ فِي الرُّومِ وَفَارِسَ فَإِذَا هُمْ يُغِيلُونَ أَوْلاَدَهُمْ فَلاَ يَضُرُّ أَوْلاَدَهُمْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَأَلُوهُ عَنِ الْعَزْلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ الْوَأْدُ الْخَفِيُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَنِ الْمُقْرِئِ وَهْىَ ‏[quran sura="81" aya_start="8" aya_end="8"]{‏ وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ‏}‏
translation_en: Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. They said: al-Muqri narrated to us. Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub narrated to us. Abu al-Aswad informed me, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb, the sister of Ukkashah. She said: I was present with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) among some people while he said: I intended to forbid intercourse during breastfeeding, but I considered the Romans and Persians and found that they nurse their children in that way, and it does not harm their children at all. Then they asked him about withdrawal, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: That is the hidden burying alive of children. Ubayd Allah added in his narration from al-Muqri: “And when the girl buried alive is asked” (Quran 81:8).
translation_de: Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. They said: al-Muqri überlieferte uns. Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub überlieferte uns. Abu al-Aswad berichtete mir, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb, the sister of Ukkashah. She said: I was present with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) among some people while he said: I intended to forbid intercourse during Stillen, but I considered the Romans and Persians and found that they nurse their children in that way, and it does not harm their children at all. Then they asked him about Coitus interruptus, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: That is the hidden burying alive of children. Ubayd Allah added in his narration from al-Muqri: “And when the girl buried alive is asked” (Quran 81:8). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1442 c, book 16, باب جَوَازِ الْغِيلَةِ وَهِيَ وَطْءُ الْمُرْضِعِ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْعَزْلِ
title: باب جَوَازِ الْغِيلَةِ وَهِيَ وَطْءُ الْمُرْضِعِ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْعَزْلِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ الْقُرَشِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ جُدَامَةَ بِنْتِ وَهْبٍ، الأَسَدِيَّةِ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ فِي الْعَزْلِ وَالْغِيلَةِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْغِيَالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Yahya ibn Ishaq narrated to us. Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal al-Qurashi, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah. She said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and he mentioned a report like Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub's hadith about withdrawal and intercourse during breastfeeding, except that he said: breastfeeding intercourse.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Yahya ibn Ishaq überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Ayyub überlieferte uns, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal al-Qurashi, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah. She said: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and he mentioned a report like Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub's hadith about Coitus interruptus and intercourse during Stillen, except that he said: Stillen intercourse. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1443, book 16, باب جَوَازِ الْغِيلَةِ وَهِيَ وَطْءُ الْمُرْضِعِ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْعَزْلِ
title: باب جَوَازِ الْغِيلَةِ وَهِيَ وَطْءُ الْمُرْضِعِ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْعَزْلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَيَّاشُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَ وَالِدَهُ، سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَعْزِلُ عَنِ امْرَأَتِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لِمَ تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ أُشْفِقُ عَلَى وَلَدِهَا أَوْ عَلَى أَوْلاَدِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ ضَارًّا ضَرَّ فَارِسَ وَالرُّومَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ زُهَيْرٌ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏"‏ إِنْ كَانَ لِذَلِكَ فَلاَ مَا ضَارَ ذَلِكَ فَارِسَ وَلاَ الرُّومَ ‏"‏.
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, and the wording is Ibn Numayr's. They both said: Abd Allah ibn Yazid al-Maqburi narrated to us. Haywah narrated to us. Ayyash ibn Abbas narrated to me that Abu al-Nadr told him, from Amir ibn Sa'd, that Usamah ibn Zayd informed his father, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: A man came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said: I practice withdrawal from my wife. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Why do you do that? The man said: I fear for her child or children. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If that were harmful, it would have harmed Persia and Rome. Zuhayr's narration says: If it were for that reason, it would not have harmed Persia or Rome.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir, and the wording is Ibn Numayr's. They both said: Abd Allah ibn Yazid al-Maqburi überlieferte uns. Haywah überlieferte uns. Ayyash ibn Abbas überlieferte mir that Abu al-Nadr told him, from Amir ibn Sa'd, that Usamah ibn Zayd informed his father, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: A man came to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: I practice Coitus interruptus from my wife. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Why do you do that? The man said: I fear for her child or children. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If that were harmful, it would have harmed Persia and Rome. Zuhayr's narration says: If it were for that reason, it would not have harmed Persia or Rome. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1444 a, book 17, باب يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الْوِلاَدَةِ ‏
title: باب يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الْوِلاَدَةِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ عِنْدَهَا وَإِنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ صَوْتَ رَجُلٍ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فِي بَيْتِ حَفْصَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا رَجُلٌ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فِي بَيْتِكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أُرَاهُ فُلاَنًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لِعَمِّ حَفْصَةَ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَ فُلاَنٌ حَيًّا - لِعَمِّهَا مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ - دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نَعَمْ إِنَّ الرَّضَاعَةَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا تُحَرِّمُ الْوِلاَدَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah. Aisha informed her that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was with her when she heard a man asking permission in Hafsah's house. Aisha said: I said: Messenger of Allah, this is a man asking permission in your house. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I think it is so-and-so, Hafsah's uncle through breastfeeding. Aisha said: Messenger of Allah, if so-and-so, her uncle through breastfeeding, were alive, would he enter upon me? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Yes. Breastfeeding makes unlawful what birth makes unlawful.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah. Aisha informed her that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) was with her when she heard a man asking permission in Hafsah's house. Aisha said: I said: Messenger of Allah, this is a man asking permission in your house. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I think it is so-and-so, Hafsah's Onkel through Stillen. Aisha said: Messenger of Allah, if so-and-so, her Onkel through Stillen, were alive, would he enter upon me? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Yes. Breastfeeding makes unlawful what birth makes unlawful. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ أَفْلَحَ - أَخَا أَبِي الْقُعَيْسِ - جَاءَ يَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَيْهَا وَهُوَ عَمُّهَا مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ بَعْدَ أَنْ أُنْزِلَ الْحِجَابُ قَالَتْ فَأَبَيْتُ أَنْ آذَنَ لَهُ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرْتُهُ بِالَّذِي صَنَعْتُ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ آذَنَ لَهُ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aisha. She informed him that Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon her. He was her uncle through breastfeeding, after the veil had been revealed. She said: I refused to give him permission. When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came, I told him what I had done, and he ordered me to give him permission to enter upon me.

She informed him that Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon her. He was her Onkel through Stillen, after the veil had been revealed. She said: I refused to give him permission. When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) came, I told him what I had done, and he ordered me to give him permission to enter upon me. title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَتَانِي عَمِّي مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ أَفْلَحُ بْنُ أَبِي قُعَيْسٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَزَادَ قُلْتُ إِنَّمَا أَرْضَعَتْنِي الْمَرْأَةُ وَلَمْ يُرْضِعْنِي الرَّجُلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكِ أَوْ يَمِينُكِ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: My uncle through breastfeeding, Aflah ibn Abi al-Qays, came to me. He mentioned something like Malik's hadith and added: I said: The woman breastfed me, but the man did not breastfeed me. He said: May your hands be covered with dust, or your right hand.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: My Onkel through Stillen, Aflah ibn Abi al-Qays, came to me. He mentioned something like Malik's hadith and added: I said: The woman breastfed me, but the man did not breastfeed me. Er sagte: May your hands be covered with dust, or your right hand. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهُ، جَاءَ أَفْلَحُ أَخُو أَبِي الْقُعَيْسِ يَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَيْهَا بَعْدَ مَا نَزَلَ الْحِجَابُ - وَكَانَ أَبُو الْقُعَيْسِ أَبَا عَائِشَةَ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ - قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ لاَ آذَنُ لأَفْلَحَ حَتَّى أَسْتَأْذِنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنَّ أَبَا الْقُعَيْسِ لَيْسَ هُوَ أَرْضَعَنِي وَلَكِنْ أَرْضَعَتْنِي امْرَأَتُهُ - قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ - فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَفْلَحَ أَخَا أَبِي الْقُعَيْسِ جَاءَنِي يَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَىَّ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ آذَنَ لَهُ حَتَّى أَسْتَأْذِنَكَ - قَالَتْ - فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ائْذَنِي لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ فَبِذَلِكَ كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ تَقُولُ حَرِّمُوا مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا تُحَرِّمُونَ مِنَ النَّسَبِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb narrated to us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah. Aisha informed him that Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter after the veil had been revealed. Abu al-Qays was Aisha's father through breastfeeding. Aisha said: By Allah, I will not give Aflah permission until I ask the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), for Abu al-Qays did not breastfeed me; his wife breastfed me. When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered, I said: Messenger of Allah, Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon me. I disliked giving him permission until I asked you. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Give him permission. Urwah said: For this reason Aisha used to say: Treat as prohibited through breastfeeding what you treat as prohibited through lineage.
translation_de: Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb überlieferte uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah. Aisha informed him that Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter after the veil had been revealed. Abu al-Qays was Aisha's father through Stillen. Aisha said: By Allah, I will not give Aflah permission until I ask der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), for Abu al-Qays did not breastfeed me; his wife breastfed me. When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) entered, I said: Messenger of Allah, Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon me. I disliked giving him permission until I asked you. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Give him permission. Urwah said: For this reason Aisha used to say: Treat as verboten through Stillen what you treat as verboten through Abstammung. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ جَاءَ أَفْلَحُ أَخُو أَبِي الْقُعَيْسِ يَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَيْهَا ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَفِيهِ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهُ عَمُّكِ تَرِبَتْ يَمِينُكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَبُو الْقُعَيْسِ زَوْجَ الْمَرْأَةِ الَّتِي أَرْضَعَتْ عَائِشَةَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, with this chain: Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon her, with wording like their hadith. It includes: He is your uncle, may your right hand be covered with dust. Abu al-Qays was the husband of the woman who breastfed Aisha.
translation_de: Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, with this chain: Aflah, the brother of Abu al-Qays, came asking permission to enter upon her, with wording like their hadith. It includes: He is your Onkel, may your right hand be covered with dust. Abu al-Qays was the husband of the woman who breastfed Aisha. title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏

translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: My uncle through breastfeeding came asking permission to enter upon me, but I refused until I asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came, I said: My uncle through breastfeeding asked permission to enter upon me, and I refused to give him permission. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Let your uncle enter upon you. I said: The woman breastfed me, but the man did not. He said: He is your uncle, so let him enter upon you.

When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) came, I said: My Onkel through Stillen asked permission to enter upon me, and I refused to give him permission. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Let your Onkel enter upon you. I said: The woman breastfed me, but the man did not. Er sagte: He is your Onkel, so let him enter upon you. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1445 h, book 17, باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ قَالَتِ، اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَىَّ عَمِّي مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ أَبُو الْجَعْدِ فَرَدَدْتُهُ - قَالَ لِي هِشَامٌ إِنَّمَا هُوَ أَبُو الْقُعَيْسِ - فَلَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرْتُهُ بِذَلِكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ أَذِنْتِ لَهُ تَرِبَتْ يَمِينُكِ أَوْ يَدُكِ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Hasan ibn Ali al-Hulwani and Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. They both said: Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ibn Jurayj informed us, from Ata. Urwah ibn al-Zubayr informed me that Aisha said: My uncle through breastfeeding, Abu al-Jad, asked permission to enter upon me, so I refused him. Hisham told me that it was Abu al-Qays. When the Prophet (peace be upon him) came, I told him. He said: Why did you not give him permission? May your right hand or hand be covered with dust.
translation_de: Hasan ibn Ali al-Hulwani and Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. They both said: Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns, from Ata. Urwah ibn al-Zubayr berichtete mir that Aisha said: My Onkel through Stillen, Abu al-Jad, asked permission to enter upon me, so I refused him. Hisham told me that it was Abu al-Qays. When der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) came, I told him. Er sagte: Why did you not give him permission? May your right hand or hand be covered with dust. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1445 i, book 17, باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ عَمَّهَا مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ - يُسَمَّى أَفْلَحَ - اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَيْهَا فَحَجَبَتْهُ فَأَخْبَرَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ لاَ تَحْتَجِبِي مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ النَّسَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Layth narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Rumh narrated to us. al-Layth informed us, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Irak, from Urwah, from Aisha. She informed him that her uncle through breastfeeding, named Aflah, asked permission to enter upon her, so she veiled herself from him. She told the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and he said to her: Do not veil yourself from him, for breastfeeding makes unlawful what lineage makes unlawful.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Layth überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Rumh überlieferte uns. al-Layth berichtete uns, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Irak, from Urwah, from Aisha. She informed him that her Onkel through Stillen, named Aflah, asked permission to enter upon her, so she veiled herself from him. She told der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and he said to her: Do not veil yourself from him, for Stillen makes unlawful what Abstammung makes unlawful. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1445 j, book 17, باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الرَّضَاعَةِ مِنْ مَاءِ الْفَحْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ، بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتِ اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَىَّ أَفْلَحُ بْنُ قُعَيْسٍ فَأَبَيْتُ أَنْ آذَنَ، لَهُ فَأَرْسَلَ إِنِّي عَمُّكِ أَرْضَعَتْكِ امْرَأَةُ أَخِي ‏.‏ فَأَبَيْتُ أَنْ آذَنَ لَهُ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لِيَدْخُلْ عَلَيْكِ فَإِنَّهُ عَمُّكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh al-Anbari narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from al-Hakam, from Irak ibn Malik, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: Aflah ibn Qays asked permission to enter upon me, but I refused. He sent word: I am your uncle; the wife of my brother breastfed you. I still refused to give him permission. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came, and I told him. He said: Let him enter upon you, for he is your uncle.
translation_de: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh al-Anbari überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from al-Hakam, from Irak ibn Malik, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: Aflah ibn Qays asked permission to enter upon me, but I refused. He sent word: I am your Onkel; the wife of my brother breastfed you. I still refused to give him permission. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came, and I told him. Er sagte: Let him enter upon you, for he is your Onkel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1446 a, book 17, باب تَحْرِيمِ ابْنَةِ الأَخِ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ ابْنَةِ الأَخِ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكَ تَنَوَّقُ فِي قُرَيْشٍ وَتَدَعُنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَعِنْدَكُمْ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ بِنْتُ حَمْزَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا لاَ تَحِلُّ لِي إِنَّهَا ابْنَةُ أَخِي مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Muhammad ibn al-Ala narrated to us, and the wording is Abu Bakr's. They said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Sa'd ibn Ubaydah, from Abu Abd al-Rahman, from Ali. I said: Messenger of Allah, why do you favor Quraysh with marriage and leave us? He said: Do you have anything? I said: Yes, Hamzah's daughter. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: She is not lawful for me; she is my niece through breastfeeding.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Muhammad ibn al-Ala überlieferte uns, and the wording is Abu Bakr's. They said: Abu Muawiyah überlieferte uns, from al-Amash, from Sa'd ibn Ubaydah, from Abu Abd al-Rahman, from Ali. I said: Messenger of Allah, why do you favor Quraysh with marriage and leave us? Er sagte: Do you have anything? I said: Yes, Hamzah's daughter. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: She is not lawful for me; she is my niece through Stillen. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.
